def avg_rate(series):
    """Return the average rate of change per unit time, rounded to 2 decimals."""
    if len(series) < 2:
        raise ValueError("At least two measurements are required.")

    elapsed_time = series[-1][0] - series[0][0]
    if elapsed_time == 0:
        raise ValueError("The first and last times must be different.")

    rate = (series[-1][1] - series[0][1]) / elapsed_time
    return f"{rate:.2f}"
